purpose: Define a versioned, deterministic, fail-closed responsibility, approval-authority, independence, and escalation evidence template for a qualified, deployment-specific governance review. This template does not assign a real person or entity, determine law, grant authority, approve a deployment, or enable runtime operation.

verified_facts: Neural Brain is product- and domain-neutral and has no accepted scoped customer or domain integration.
The current repository does not establish a concrete provider, deployer, controller, processor, operating entity, incident responder, release authority, or deployment.
The protected Memory Core is an internal subsystem and cannot narrow the complete cognitive-system product boundary established by ADR-018.
unknown_facts_not_inferred: the legal or operational responsibility of a concrete person, organization, provider, deployer, or deployment
the authority, qualification, availability, independence, or delegation of any concrete approver, policy author, policy activator, incident responder, or release authority
whether a concrete deployment may process data, be released, operated, or have any external effect

assessment_template.assessment_unit: One immutable artifact version or digest, concrete proposed deployment, intended purpose, authenticated Tenant, Area, and Project scope combination, and responsibility assignment version.
approval_authority_rules: Every proposed approval must cite a pre-existing authenticated authority source, immutable scope, operation, policy decision, required approval type, expiry, and independent evidence reference.

Approval records are evidence of a separately governed decision only; approval cannot create missing authority, expand scope, substitute a policy decision, remove a Security Floor prohibition, or enable a protected-state transition or external effect.

A requester may not be the sole approver for elevated-risk work, and a policy author may not be the sole policy activator; any exception is invalid unless separately authorized by an accepted control-plane contract and independently evidenced.
Release accountability cannot substitute an Action, Goal, Memory, or Model Promotion Gate, independent verification, kill switch, sandbox, budget, resource claim, fence, or atomic audit requirement.
escalation_rules: Escalation records a concern, owner, evidence, deadline, and next review action; it is not an approval, authority grant, policy activation, release decision, or runtime command.

An escalation cannot bypass, waive, reorder, or satisfy a Protected Control Plane gate, Security Floor prohibition, independent-review requirement, delivery-stage gate, recognition gate, or release stop.
Unknown, unavailable, conflicted, expired, or non-independent responsibility, approval, or escalation evidence keeps the proposed deployment-specific release decision blocked.
Incident escalation preserves indeterminate-effect handling: ambiguous external effects require authoritative reconciliation before retry or resource release.

authority_boundary.template_is: a versioned governance and traceability input for separately governed qualified review
template_is_not: a legal opinion, compliance certification, or factual assignment of a real provider, deployer, privacy, security, product, incident, or release role
a deployment, processing, productive-use, or release approval
an authority grant, policy decision, human approval, delegation, or Security Floor override
an authenticated Tenant, Area, Project, Session, or principal context
a protected-state transition request, Gate decision, or runtime capability enablement
an implementation, maturity, recognition, safety, or production-autonomy claim
authority_boundary.release_boundary: Only separately authorized release governance, qualified applicable review, and every applicable Protected Control Plane, transition-gate, evaluation, recognition, and evidence requirement may decide a concrete deployment. This template cannot activate a runtime path or replace an independent control-plane decision.

current_blocker.unblock_condition: A concrete proposed deployment supplies every required field, immutable artifact and scope evidence, qualified governance review, unambiguous responsibility assignments, authenticated authority sources, independence evidence, gate-preserving escalation paths, reassessment triggers, and an independent release decision for separate governance evaluation.
current_blocker.next_step: Create one immutable responsibility assessment record per proposed deployment artifact and authenticated scope before any deployment-specific release decision.
